title: Stale BG number on Always On Display
symptom: The BG number shown on the Always On Display is often stale, showing a reading from 15 minutes prior or even older, while the current BG is different. The issue persists even after unlocking the screen and opening xDrip, but the notification area shows the correct current BG.
cause: The developer suggested it might be the always on display caching the data, but no definitive root cause was established.
evidence_quote: I think this might be the always on display caching the data. If you unlock the phone does the notification area instantly have the correct number icon?
